newsitem.title: CHINA: China total crop area to increase 1.05 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China total crop area to increase 1.05 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's area sown to all crops will increase by 1.6 million hectares or 1.05 percent this year over 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The total sown area would reach 153 million hectares this year, it quoted the State Statistics Bureau as saying.
Grain, oil-bearing and sugar crop areas would increase while cotton, linen and medicinal crop areas will decline, it said.
The crop area in the southern part of the country would be higher while in the north the area would decrease.

The bureau attributed the change to greater attention to grain production in the south. Northern provinces, suffering from monoculture and lower grain prices, had cut grain plantings this year, it said.
The area planted to grain would reach 112.55 million hectares, up 0.36 percent from last year, with the summer grain area rising by 2.67 percent, it said.
China last week said it had revised its total grain output for 1996 to 490 million tonnes from an earlier record 480 tonnes.
